issues.detail: The instructions lack explicit error handling or edge case guidance.

scenarios.name: pi-hole-dns-integration
scenarios.rationale: Response A provides more comprehensive steps and starts WireGuard before Pi‑hole, but both miss key rubric items such as pihole‑FTL dns.listeningMode, explicit client DNS setting to 10.10.0.1, and monitoring commands; A covers more of the required content.
